verdict.rationale: Channel3 accepts MPP machine payments from agents for calls to its own product-data API. Nothing in the pack shows it lets a developer put HTTP 402 per-call payments on their own API or service. Its developer monetization is affiliate commission on product sales, which is a different capability, so the axis applies but is not delivered.

support.subject: As a developer, I can monetize an API or service with HTTP 402 machine payments that agents pay per call without a checkout UI
